latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of the uplo-environmental skill for AI-powered environmental knowledge management.
- Enables structured search and extraction from impact assessments, compliance data, sustainability reports, and environmental permits.
- Introduces key tools: search_with_context, search_knowledge, get_directives, report_knowledge_gap, and flag_outdated.
- Provides example workflows for permit renewal and carbon footprint reduction planning.
- Includes operational tips for handling temporal data, compliance status, and access-restricted records.
